title: Let people change rankings inline

statement.en: Let people change an individual item’s ranking inline without opening a separate editing screen.
statement.ja: separate editing screenを開かずに個別itemのrankingをinlineで変更できるようにする。

conditions: The interface presents a list of ranked items.

rationale.en: Applying this guidance supports a consistent and usable Rating indicators experience on the scoped Apple platforms.
rationale.ja: この指針は、対象AppleプラットフォームにおけるRating indicatorsの一貫性と使いやすさを支えます。

manual: Does the design satisfy “Let people change an individual item’s ranking inline without opening a separate editing screen.” in the documented Rating indicators context?

anti_patterns: Ignoring this guidance in a context where the source section applies.
positive_examples: A design review records how the implementation satisfies this rule and any source-scoped exception.

source.evidence_paraphrase: Let people change an individual item’s ranking inline without opening a separate editing screen.

apple_native_rule: Let people change an individual item’s ranking inline without opening a separate editing screen.
portable_interpretation: Preserve the user-centered intent after replacing Apple-specific platforms, components, and input conventions.

title: Make custom rating symbols clear

statement.en: Make sure the purpose of a custom macOS rating symbol is clear.
statement.ja: custom macOS rating symbolのpurposeを明確にする。

conditions: The app replaces the recognizable default star with a custom symbol.
